title: §.XII late (1): Whole-AC approvers ready to subscribe — Bucer & Calvin (even outside Germany)
pass_a_gloss: To the prior genus we refer as many as, even established outside the bounds of Germany, either (1) approve the whole Augsburg Confession and are ready to subscribe to it (such as formerly were Bucer and Calvin; on the former of whom Chytraeus in his History passim pp. 651 and 656, 659; on the latter the Author of the ausführlicher Behauptung 20 in a peculiar disquisition: Whether the late Herr Joh. Calvin was held in his time for an Augsburg Confession kinsman or not? from p. 72 to 90. Add Pareus in the Irenicum p. 293.);
pass_b_english: Under the looser class we put all who, even outside Germany, either (1) approve the whole Augsburg Confession and stand ready to subscribe — as Bucer and Calvin once did.

On Bucer see Chytraeus's History at pp. 651, 656, and 659; on Calvin, the Author of the ausführlicher Behauptung 20, in the special inquiry whether the late John Calvin was counted an Augsburg Confession kinsman in his day (pp. 72–90); add Pareus, Irenicum, p. 293.
source_text: Ad prius genus referimus, quotquot, etiam extra fines Germaniae constituti, vel (1) totam Augustanam Confessionem approbant eique subscribere parati sunt (quales olim fuerunt Bucerus & Calvinus, de quorum priori passim Chytraeus Hist. sua pag. 651. & 656. 659.; de posteriori Auctor der ausführlicher Behauptung 20. peculiari disquisitione: Ob Herr Joh. Calvinus seeliger für einen Augspurgischen Confessions-Verwandten zu seiner Zeit sey gehalten worden/ oder nicht? a pag. 72. ad 90. Adde Pareum in Irenico pag. 293.);

choices.why: keep German title sense; Verwandter = confessional relative
